Resolves #18031

Refs #17540

A new guide, `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsMechanics.md`, follows real gestures across the dock's commit boundary on a live page — a split resize, an edge resize, a tab moved inside its header and into another zone — and then the paths that commit nothing. It separates the five places a gesture's state lives (pixels, preview, descriptor, committed document, projection), explains why the projection waits a tick, which of its two paths a commit takes and how both keep live panes instead of rebuilding them, and names each owner at its seam without cataloguing it. It is registered in `learn/tree.json` and the SEO `PRIORITIES` input.

Evidence: L3 (receipts read with a real pointer on the standalone dock example and the Workstation in headless Chromium, on the DOM, the committed document and the live instances, plus a portal render against a merged-guide control) → L2 required (documentation). No residual beyond the cross-family whole-guide review this PR requests.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Owner names moved.** The ticket's `model/Document.mjs` is `model/WorkspaceDocument.mjs` on dev; the other owners it names are where it put them.
- **Tab movement, traced in two shapes.** The in-header reorder is told apart from the cross-zone move because the reorder is where identity broke: the first receipts exposed #18652, and this PR waited for #18660 so the guide describes the fixed behaviour.
- **The refusal arms are source-held.** The negative-arm receipts are the Escape arms and the release over nothing. A refused descriptor and the locked-source refusal are read from `WorkspaceDocument.commit`, the view-sync's success gate and the reducer, not from a UI outcome.
- **One overclaim, corrected before opening.** The five-hands list said nothing but the reducer writes the committed document. `2d153fd796` says what the source says: `applyDockZoneOperation` writes nothing, and the view-sync stores a committed result. It is the class Emmy's R1 on #18665 found, looked for here before review.

## Test Evidence

Receipts ran against `700f257e4a` (`dev@5dc6b80fef` plus #18660) with the bridge routed off. This branch sits on `dev@28584754ff`. Up to `3044d7f86b`, the paths the receipts and source reads touched (`src/component/Splitter.mjs`, `src/main/addon`, `src/draggable`, `src/dashboard`, `src/tab`, `resources/scss`, `examples/dashboard/dock`) were unchanged, and the four changed Workstation files touched neither its drag composition nor its arrangement. From `3044d7f86b` to `28584754ff`, two commits touch those paths, and neither changes a receipt (source-held, not re-run): #18664 routes a tear-out vessel's close through one engine routine, and no receipt opens or closes a vessel; #18667 stops the reconciler pairing a card with an item it cannot trust (a card that names another item, or an unnamed card while the header's ids and the cards differ in count), and in every receipt gesture the ids and cards stay aligned and equal in count, so each card pairs as before.

- **Split resize** (example, 1600 × 1000): `[0.65, 0.35]` paints 772 / 416 px; 90 px right holds 862 / 326 px with `flex: 0 0 auto`, pair total 1,188 px, document unchanged; release commits `[0.7257566…, 0.2742434…]` against a painted 0.7257566; same splitter instance.
- **Escape mid-resize:** 120 px left paints 742 / 446 px; Escape restores 862 / 326 px with `flex` `0.725757 1 0%` / `0.274243 1 0%`; document identical; same splitter instance.
- **Edge resize:** `extent: 0.25` (400 px) dragged 80 px paints 480 px while the center keeps `flex: 1 1 0%` at 1,114 px; release commits `extent: 0.3`. Dragged 900 px the other way, the preview stops at 128 px and commits `extent: 0.08`.
- **In-header reorder:** Swarm behind Timeline commits strategy, metrics, timeline, swarm, agents, alerts, history with `activeItemId: swarm`; the header reads Strategy, Metrics, Timeline, Swarm, active index 3.
- **Cross-zone move:** Metrics into Logs commits `[logs, metrics]`; the marked pane DOM node sits in the Logs tab container, one Metrics pane on the page.
- **Workstation preview:** Resident Activity over the queue and graph stack shows `tab-into` · `left-tabs` · `accepted` with nine indicators; release commits `left-tabs` `[queues, graph, activity]`, active `activity`, payload back to `null`, no indicators.
- **Zero-commit arms:** Escape over the Workstation preview (payload `null`, no indicators, document equal across 20 items and 9 nodes); Timeline held over Terminal, then Escape; Agents released over the perspective toolbar — each with the document unchanged.
- **Portal render** (headless Chromium, `7b036e9366`): `#/learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsMechanics` shows its H1, 9 sections and 1 diagram of 9 nodes with the authored labels, no syntax error. Control `DockLayoutsStyling` on the same path: 1 diagram of 9 nodes. Both pages throw the same pre-existing App Worker `TypeError` from `SectionsList.getItemRecordId`.
- **Independent Mermaid control** (`7b036e9366`): the fence renders in a blank document; a deliberately broken fence fails to parse.
- **Lint and structure** (`7b036e9366`): Brain `lint-guides` from `neo-agent-brain@f50e93e`, 0 hard / 0 warn on the full rule set and on the guide-series ticket-id scan, with warnings counted as errors; `check-relative-links` OK (222 links across 165 files); tree 142 items, no duplicates or orphans, every leaf backed by a file.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** RA-1 [P2] — Distinguish the full staged projection from validated in-place updates.
      **Commit:** 7b036e9366
      **Details:** `Why the projection waits a tick` now names two paths: a commit that only moves boundaries, or only locks or unlocks items, asks the reconciler to update the current shell in place, and it does so only after proving the structure unchanged node by node; a projection that does not land in place takes the four phases. Destruction is qualified where you pointed — a retained tab container that is itself the projected root takes the staged shell's place, so it is both shells at once and there is nothing to swap or destroy. Read at `28584754ff`: `Workspace#getRefreshOptions` (a homogeneous `geometry` batch requests `geometryOnly`, `itemFlags` requests `retainTopology`), `Operations.operationChangeClass` (`setItemLocked` is the only item-flag entry — pinning and auto-hiding are topology because they move a pane between the shell and a rail), `Reconciler.reconcileProjection` (`landedInPlace`, and the fall-through when `reconcileStableTopology` returns null) and `.moveRetainedTabChrome` (`retainedRoot`).

Your [RETROSPECTIVE] applies past that paragraph, so three more sentences now state the guarantee instead of one path: the intro's "hands the live components … to their new places" → "keeps the live components you were looking at", the diagram's "live panes move" → "live panes are kept", and the cross-zone story's "Nothing was rebuilt" → "The pane was not rebuilt" (a staged projection does build new split containers; what the receipt measured was the pane). "Stays exactly where it is" went too, because the staged path contradicts it — a retained container is re-parented into its staged slot — so reconciliation is now described as pairing tab containers by the id of their stack. Census over the whole guide for `each projection|every projection|in place|shell|rebuil|did not move|stays exactly|new places|re-projection`: every remaining hit is the naive design being described, a measured receipt, or the Workstation clearing its affordances on every refresh.

The same paragraph now says a listener "can outlive the order it closed over" rather than "stays attached … for as long as that component survives in place". The mechanism, probed in the unit runtime at this head with a control: `moveRetainedTabChrome` does re-set `listeners`, but `Neo.isEqual` compares functions by name and source, so `LayoutAdapter`'s same-source arrows compare equal and `afterSetListeners` never runs. Out of scope for this guide — sent as a defect-note, no action requested.

PR-body facts corrected in place: the opening sentence (now "which of its two paths a commit takes and how both keep live panes instead of rebuilding them"), AC-4's source list, the `Deltas` SHA after the rebase (`62d0352764` → `2d153fd796`), and Test Evidence's base, portal-render head and lint lines. The branch now sits on `dev@28584754ff`; the two commits since your base that touch receipt paths are dispositioned there as source-held rather than re-run: #18664 (no receipt opens or closes a vessel) and #18667 (in every receipt gesture the header's ids and its cards stay aligned and equal in count, so each card pairs as before).
